title: Progress

setupView.intro: Set up how this project's progress is measured. Daily reports and performance start once work packages and milestones exist.

workPackages.title: Work packages
workPackages.description: Split the BOQ into the packages progress is tracked by. Each package gets BOQ items and a share of the overall weight.
workPackages.startFromBoqBody: Proposes one work package for each BOQ section that still has unallocated items, weighted by that section's share of the BOQ value. You can rename packages, move items between them or leave some out before anything is created.
workPackages.gapAllocation: {codes} {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} no BOQ items yet, so {count, plural, one {its} other {their}} progress can't be measured. Allocate items to {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
workPackages.gapWeights: Package weights total {total}%. They need to add up to 100% for overall progress to be right — suggest them from BOQ values, or set them per package.
workPackages.summary: {packages, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} · weights total {weights}% · {allocation}
workPackages.scheduleOnlyNote: The packages so far are schedule-only phases. Progress needs at least one package that carries BOQ items.

baseline.title: Planned baseline
baseline.description: Lock a planned progress curve so Performance compares actual progress against a real plan instead of an estimate.

baseline.title: Planned baseline
baseline.subtitle: The planned progress curve the S-curve compares actuals against. Without one, the planned line is only an estimate.
baseline.workingCurveNote: This is the working curve — edit it freely. It stages the next baseline but does not change variance until you approve or re-baseline below.

governing.none: No baseline is governing yet. The S-curve compares against an estimate until you approve one.
governing.pointCount: {count, plural, one {# frozen point} other {# frozen points}}
governing.unpublishedHint: The working curve differs from the governing baseline. These staged changes do not affect variance until you re-baseline.
governing.approveNeedsCurve: Save a planned curve first, then lock it.
governing.rebaselineSubtitle: Snapshot the current working curve as a new governing baseline. This supersedes the previous version and must cite a Variation.
governing.variationHint: A re-baseline must be justified by an approved change to scope or time.
governing.noteHint: Recorded on the new baseline version for the audit trail.
governing.noContract: This project has no main contract yet, so there are no variations to cite. A re-baseline needs a variation.
governing.noVariations: This contract has no variations to cite. Raise a variation before re-baselining.
governing.lockHint: Locking freezes this curve as the plan progress is measured against. Changing it later needs a rebaseline that cites a variation.

baseline.noDates: Set the project start and end dates to generate a linear baseline.
baseline.empty: Add points, or start from a generator above.
baseline.errorRange: Each cumulative % must be between 0 and 100.
baseline.errorOrder: Cumulative % cannot go backwards over time.

signal.title: Cost vs physical progress
signal.costAheadHint: Spending is running ahead of physical progress — investigate the variance.
signal.progressAheadHint: Physical progress is ahead of recorded cost.
signal.alignedHint: Physical progress and cost are broadly aligned.
signal.insufficientHint: There is no forecast cost yet, so no comparison can be made.

collectionSignal.title: Collection vs physical progress
collectionSignal.alignedHint: Collection and physical progress are broadly aligned.
collectionSignal.cashAheadHint: Collection is running ahead of physical progress — the client is financing the work; watch advance exposure.
collectionSignal.workAheadHint: Physical progress is ahead of collection — ACCO is financing the client; chase certification and billing.
collectionSignal.insufficientHint: There is no contract value yet, so no comparison can be made.
